content.input:
{"summary": "Added a light/dark preview-scheme toggle to the canvas-theme-editor scaffold template's preview header:

- **app.html**: new `#preview-scheme-toggle` button placed after the preview-width picker, initially disabled with the `-icon-moon` class (mirrors the existing preview-fullscreen-toggle pattern).
- **i18n.json**: new `previewSchemeToggleLabel` string.
- **main.ts.tmpl**:
  - Imported `moon.css`/`sun.css` icons.
  - Added `syncDarkModeAvailability()` — disables/unchecks "Include dark mode" whenever the theme isn't `rebrand` (canvas/canvasHighContrast don't support dark mode), replacing the old row-hiding-only logic at all three call sites (postMessage theme apply, theme button click, preset restore).
  - Added `syncPreviewSchemeToggleAvailability()` — disables the new toggle (and resets it to light/moon) unless "Include dark mode" is checked; wired into the checkbox's `change` handler.
  - Added `previewDarkOverride` state + click handler toggling the button's pressed state/icon.
  - `updatePreview()`'s `previewScheme` now also requires `previewDarkOverride` before rendering the preview in dark mode.
- **app.css**: `.preview-header` now uses `space-between`/`align-items: center` so the new toggle sits at the end of the row.

Regenerated the scaffold's bundled templates (`vp run generate`), ran `vp check --fix` (only pre-existing, unrelated `@module` TSDoc lint noise remains), and verified `packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts` and `cli.test.ts` (80 tests) pass. content.input:
{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/repo/lightningcss-light-dark-downlevel.md", "file_text": "# lightningcss downlevels light-dark() to OS-preference only — breaks manual scheme toggles

`@pantoken/css`'s built token sheets (`style*.lean.css`, and even `scope.lean.css`/`properties.lean.css`
if built through `vp pack`, which shares the same lightningcss minify config) declare tokens as
native `light-dark(a, b)` in `generated/*.css`, but `vp pack`'s CSS minify step (lightningcss)
**downlevels every `light-dark()` call** into:

```css
--token: var(--lightningcss-light, a) var(--lightningcss-dark, b);
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :where(html) { --lightningcss-light: ; --lightningcss-dark: initial; } }
```

This means the built/shipped CSS's dark mode **only follows the visitor's OS/browser preference**
— setting `color-scheme: dark` (inline style or via a `[data-pantoken-scheme="dark"]` rule) does
NOT force it, because the downlevel form never reads `color-scheme` at all, just the media query.
This affects flat sheets AND (if built via `vp pack`) the newer `scope.css`/`properties.css` pair
too — `formats/css/generated/scope.lean.css` uses real `light-dark()` pre-minify (that's why
`formats/css/tests/manual/scope-test.html`, which loads straight from `generated/`, passes), but
`formats/css/dist/scope.lean.css` (post `vp pack`) does not.

**Workaround (no core package changes needed)**: append a small override block keyed to whatever
attribute/class you use to force scheme, redeclaring lightningcss's own (fixed, stable) control
variables directly:

```css
[data-pantoken-scheme="light"] { --lightningcss-light: initial; --lightningcss-dark: ; }
[data-pantoken-scheme="dark"] { --lightningcss-light: ; --lightningcss-dark: initial; }
```

`--x: initial` on an unregistered custom property produces the guaranteed-invalid value, so
`var(--lightningcss-dark, fallbackColor)` falls back to `fallbackColor`; `--x: ;` (empty) makes that
var() resolve to nothing, so only one side of the concatenation contributes. Used in
`packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl`'s `PREVIEW_SCHEME_FORCE_CSS` to
make the canvas-theme-editor preview's manual light/dark toggle actually override the OS setting.

Real fix (not done — bigger, riskier, touches a shared package's byte-for-byte build output) would
be tuning `formats/css/vite.config.ts`'s `pack.css.target`/lightningcss targets so `light-dark()`
isn't downleveled at all for browsers that support it natively.
"}

content.input:
{"summary": "Found and fixed the real bug: pantoken's built token CSS (`@pantoken/css`'s `style*.lean.css`) declares dark-mode support via `light-dark()`, but the package's `vp pack` build step (lightningcss) downlevels that into a form that only reacts to the browser's own OS `prefers-color-scheme` — completely ignoring the `color-scheme`/`data-pantoken-scheme` attribute the preview sets. That's why toggling did nothing visually: it flipped attributes correctly, but nothing in the actual CSS read them.

Fix (scoped entirely to the scaffold template, no core package changes):
- Added `PREVIEW_SCHEME_FORCE_CSS` in `main.ts.tmpl`, a tiny override block that redeclares lightningcss's own downlevel control variables (`--lightningcss-light`/`--lightningcss-dark`) keyed to `[data-pantoken-scheme="light"|"dark"]`, forcing the resolved branch regardless of OS preference.
- Appended it into the preview's `<style>` block in `updatePreview()`.
- (Explored and reverted a larger fix — swapping to `@pantoken/css`'s newer scoped `properties.css`/`scope.css` pair, which isn't fully wired into that package's `vp pack` output either — in favor of this much smaller, lower-risk, self-contained workaround.)

Verified live in a browser against the docs' `/guide/canvas-rce` page (rebuilt via `docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts`): toggling now correctly forces the preview background between white (light) and the dark surface color, round-tripping both directions, independent of the test environment's own dark OS preference.

Regenerated the scaffold bundle, reran `packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts`/`cli.test.ts` (80 passing), `vp check --fix` (only pre-existing unrelated `@module` TSDoc baseline errors remain), and updated the changeset to describe the OS-preference-override fix. Saved a repo-memory note (`lightningcss-light-dark-downlevel.md`) documenting the root cause and workaround for future reference."}
